description: List the ports that should never be reachable from the internet (databases, queues, admin panels). Returns ports, each a port number and the service that usually listens on it. Use it to pick ports when asked to watch a server for exposed services; it creates nothing. Then create one TCP monitor on the server's public hostname or IP with config {"ports": [...], "expected_state": "closed"} (1 to 20 distinct ports, one region, interval_seconds 300 or more; 3600 is plenty) through create_monitor: it counts as one monitor and fails naming every port that answers.
name: get_exposed_ports_preset
title: Get the exposed-ports preset
